Wheels appear to be 26-inch class (seller says 26 MTB; photo does not show a clear wheel-size marking).
Brand/model text appears on the frame near the top tube (looks like 'KONGA' or similar), but it is not fully legible.
Front derailleur/gear area is visible; exact gear count/model is not readable.
Tyres look intact from this angle; tread condition is not clearly verifiable.
No clear close-ups of brake pads, chain condition, drivetrain wear, or suspension travel/operation.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 clearly shows front suspension, but rear suspension (true dual-suspension) is not clearly visible.
Photo 0 does not show a clear wheel-size label; only the overall wheel class can be guessed.
Design quality is subjective and not verifiable from this single photo.
Tyres look present and not obviously torn, but tread depth, sidewall cracks, and puncture history are not verifiable.
No functional test shown; drivetrain/brake wear and operation cannot be confirmed from still images.
No clear photo of adjustment range (seatpost height markings, stem adjustment, etc.).

risks.risk: It may not be true dual-suspension (could be only front suspension). This affects value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear triangle showing whether there is a rear shock/hinge (or a video riding over a bump).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a front-suspension hardtail (not dual-suspension).

risks.risk: Brake performance and brake pad wear are unknown; disc brakes may be squealing, warped rotor, or pads near end-of-life.
risks.proof: Close-up of brake pads + rotor condition, and a short video braking from speed.

risks.risk: Drivetrain condition (chain stretch, cassette/freewheel wear, shifting accuracy) is unknown.
risks.proof: Video shifting through all gears smoothly + close-up of chain and cassette/freewheel teeth.
risks.if_unproven: Price as drivetrain may need cleaning/tuning (and possibly parts).

risks.risk: Wheel alignment/rim damage and tyre health (sidewall cracks, bulges) are not verifiable from one wide shot.
risks.proof: Photos of both wheels close-up (rims, spokes, tyre sidewalls) and a spin test video showing wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres/rims may require replacement or truing.

risks.risk: Frame size/fit and exact model are unclear; wrong size reduces buyer value.
risks.proof: Photo of the frame size marking (if any) and measurement from seat tube top to center (or seller states exact size).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic 26-inch MTB with unknown fit.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the rear suspension area (rear shock/hinge) to confirm whether it is truly dual-suspension.
Send a short video: ride forward, shift through all gears, and brake hard (front and rear if present).
Send close-ups of chain + cassette/freewheel + derailleur alignment.
Send close-ups of brake pads and rotor (both sides) and tyre sidewalls (cracks/bulges).
Send a photo showing any frame size marking and/or provide frame measurements.
response.reason: From photo 0 it looks like a 26-inch MTB hardtail with front suspension and disc brake, but key value drivers (true dual-suspension, brake/drivetrain condition, tyre health, and exact size/model) are not verifiable remotely. Request the specific proof shots/videos before pricing.
